stem:
Sagar must rewrite $7 - 18$ by replacing subtraction with addition of an additive inverse.

Which rewrite is correct?

options.text: Call the step addition only, with no inverse stated.
$7 - 18 = (-7) + (-18)$, applying the inverse to the first integer.
$7 - 18 = 7 + (-18)$, because subtracting $18$ is adding the additive inverse of $18$.
The values of $7$ and $18$ come from first writing $7 + (-18)$.

teacher.key_rationale: Subtracting 18 is adding its additive inverse −18, so 7−18=7+(−18). A names addition without the inverse. B inverts the wrong integer. D reverses the rewrite and the original expression.
